During the [[New Sith Wars]], a '''battle''' was fought on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] sometime between [[1004 BBY]] and the [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan]] and was won by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].
